correctness.rationale: Adjunction and anticanonical ampleness force every negative integral curve to have square -1 and anticanonical degree one. The ten standard blowup classes realize the Kneser labeling, and an intersecting pair already gives a singular two-by-two principal submatrix. The six mutually exclusive sorts of independent sets give the claimed 76. For an invariant disjoint support B, D=-K+2B is defined over the base; its positive part -K+B is nef by the exceptional generators of the Mori cone, has square 5+|B|, and vanishes exactly on B, while N=B has all coefficients positive. These strict conditions away from B and the linear projection orthogonal to B give a class in the chamber interior. Independently counted fixed edge pairs, label triangles and stars with a fixed center for every power of each class representative, and inverted fixed counts to orbit counts; all seven vectors and orbit spectra agree (python3 /workspace/branches/independent_arithmetic.py). All types occur even over F2: blow up the split projective frame; its four-point permutations give S4 and standard Cremona at three of the frame points lifts and induces (4 5) in the given labeling. These automorphisms are defined over the base and generate S5, so finite-field twisting realizes every assigned permutation (its inverse has the same type). This independently supplies the cited finite-field realizability. The cycle-count argument, not the sample, proves all extension counts. The frozen script was inspected, not run; its advertised Python 3.8 minimum is a minor replay typo (int.bit_count requires 3.10+).

value.rationale: This is a complete classification of actual ground-field negative-part regimes on a natural family of all finite-field forms, not just a graph count with no arithmetic meaning. For instance a four-cycle has a rational non-nef chamber with four conjugate negative curves and no rational exceptional curve, whereas a five-cycle leaves no non-nef chamber. The all-power table determines exact extension degrees for descent of the chamber data, together with support cardinality at the ground field. The geometric count and known arithmetic cone/lattice invariants alone are not the claimed census.
